Namaste, main CBI cyber crime se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel pakda gaya hai jisme drugs hain. Aapke khilaaf arrest warrant hai. Ye bahut confidential case hai, kisi ko mat batana. Abhi AnyDesk download karo aur verification deposit RBI safe account mein transfer karo, warna turant giraftari hogi.
